source: v88 real receiver foot contact often increases ball speed (s02 about 0.86 to 1.04 m/s), followed by sideways escape; v93/v94 cannot chase it back into a second shot. Existing committed-receive teacher has -1 rad aim bias and +0.35 m/s follow-through.
hypothesis: A receive teacher with less sideways aim, less forward follow-through and/or deeper cushion may safely produce a genuinely slower post-contact ball in the full six-G1 physics world. This is only a data-source reachability check, not a learned runtime policy.
paired_parent: v88 0.35 m, default teacher, same consumed scenes
positive_sample_gate: 3/3 six-body safe, clean physical source/receiver foot transfer, no nonfoot ball contact, and 3/3 lower post-receive ball speed at first foot contact than paired parent; mean post-receive speed <=0.75 of parent, plus no new robot-robot collision. A later genuine second foot shot is separately reported.
interpretation: Even a teacher pass cannot be promoted. Labels must be collected and a teacher-free actor must pass a new, sealed multi-agent Fresh exam before any growth claim.
